question: Under what condition is aviation death covered under the base policy for this insured?
expected_answer: Aviation death is covered because the standard aviation exclusion has been waived based on the insured's declared private pilot activities, with an additional premium of $175/year included. The only remaining exception is military combat operations.
evidence: SECTION 6: AVIATION EXCLUSION WAIVER: The standard aviation exclusion has been waived for this policy based on the insured's declared private pilot activities. Additional premium of $175/year is included in the base premium. Coverage includes death while: Operating or riding as a passenger in any aircraft / Exception: military combat operations
